run_convert_benchmark_txt_to_json: run convert.py with a benchmark name argument to parse out_<name>.txt and write out_<name>.json
parse_line_chm: parse concurrent hash map benchmark output lines into a dictionary of thread count and average latency
parse_line_lzbench: parse lzbench compression benchmark output lines into a dictionary of compression and decompression throughput
parse_line_openssl: parse openssl benchmark output lines into a dictionary of throughput values for different buffer sizes
parse_line_generic: parse generic benchmark output lines into a dictionary of benchmark names and iterations per second
